steps.name: start temporary Postgres
steps.cmd: {python} -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess; Path('.env').write_bytes(Path('.env.example').read_bytes()); raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(['docker','compose','-p','{project}','up','-d','--wait']))"

steps.name: run SQL once
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U learner -d code101 -f /scripts/lesson.sql
